comparison.objective: Load a corded blender into a service lift and actuate it without trapping the cord; candidate commissions an isolated robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable management, appliance placement, and button pressing differ from hex-key alignment, fine adjustment, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Blender must travel in the lift with its cord untrapped; exact indexed clearance thresholds are absent. Candidate has quantified energy, velocity, stroke, and retention checks.
comparison.reason: Physical button actuation is the only shared primitive and does not establish overlap.
